notes: «قال سألت سعيد بن جبير» makes Hilal the asker, a link (rule 5); Sa'id is the one asked and answers

«- يعني عكرمة -» is an editor's gloss naming whom «حديثه» refers to; the text does not name the speaker of «فحدثني», so no name is added (rules 6 and 9) and the gap is unnamed (rule 8). Flagged for a ruling
The Prophet ends the chain through Ibn Abbas's report of Dubā'a's question
